page: UpCloud GPU-32xCPU-384GB-3xL4 is an x86_64 architecture server virtualized via the KVM hypervisor. The system features 32 vCPUs with a shared CPU allocation model. It is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding 12.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

Hardware acceleration is driven by three NVIDIA L4 GPUs based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, providing a combined total of 72 GB of VRAM. This server configuration does not include local storage, meaning external block storage must be attached for persistent data. Network connectivity includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

The shared CPU allocation model presents a resource-density tradeoff, reducing CPU-bound predictability compared to dedicated cores, but offering a more cost-efficient entry point for GPU-heavy workloads. This hardware profile is designed for workloads requiring substantial GPU acceleration and memory capacity, such as machine learning inference, graphics rendering, data science pipelines, and distributed analytical databases.
